patterns.note: The hero section features an asymmetrical, collage-like arrangement of disparate, seemingly random images overlapping with large, decorative text.
Content sections below the hero utilize a balanced mix of full-width text blocks, two-column layouts, and image grids, often integrating large product imagery centrally.
A high-contrast, limited color palette dominates, primarily using stark white and vibrant red backgrounds with black text for a bold visual statement.
The hero background dramatically changes from white to red on scroll, while scattered images reposition, scale, and parallax, and the main hero text transforms with a strike-through effect.
Subsequent content sections are revealed with a subtle slide-up and fade-in animation as they enter the viewport, creating a staggered content reveal.

A strong typographic contrast is used, pairing an elegant, traditional serif for main headings and body text with a bold, raw, almost handwritten-style sans-serif for key display elements and calls to action.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a complex scroll-triggered animation system, likely using webgl-three for 3D transformations or advanced layering, to dynamically change the background color, reposition and scale multiple overlapping image elements, and apply text transformations (like a strike-through) as the user scrolls.

Subsequent content sections are revealed using css-keyframes or a JavaScript animation library, appearing with a subtle upward slide and fade effect as they enter the viewport, creating a staggered content reveal.

The overall layout combines free-form, overlapping elements in the hero with more structured, yet still visually dynamic, content blocks below, often featuring large imagery or product shots integrated into text columns.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, decorative hero text is used for brand impact. Main headings are elegant serifs (~2-3x body text), complemented by bold, uppercase sans-serif labels for calls to action.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy in the hero section, balanced in editorial text blocks, and dense in product display grids.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its highly dynamic and unconventional hero section, which transforms dramatically on scroll with a background color change, parallaxing collage of images, and text animation. This creates an immediate, memorable, and art-directed brand experience that feels more like an interactive art piece than a typical marketing page.
